documents.title: October close at WD+6 — September took WD+11 on Business Central
documents.source_ref: SDP Month-End Close Control Tower — 12 close feeds, October 2026
documents.excerpt: September was the first close on Business Central: the BC API timed out under month-end volume and finance rebuilt the books from the Data Lake by hand over three days. October has 96.8% of records landed and 93.8% auto-matched on NOK 1,357M under close.

documents.title: BC API timeout on 2.1M journal lines — Data Lake fallback completed the feed
documents.source_ref: SDP Close Control Tower — ingestion monitor, Business Central GL feed
documents.excerpt: The BC OData API timed out after 1.4M of 2.1M October journal lines. The ingestion agent switched to paged extraction from the Data Lake replica and checked the result against the BC trial balance — no manual workaround this month.

documents.title: Ski stock cover in Trøndelag at 2.1 weeks before the winter peak
documents.source_ref: SDP Inventory & Stockout Intelligence — store stock × ML demand forecast
documents.excerpt: Intersport Trondheim City Syd and Solsiden have 2.1 weeks of alpine and cross-country cover against a 6-week target before week 50. Estimated sales at risk NOK 8.6M (NOK 3.2M gross margin) unless DC stock is re-allocated from Oslo this week.

documents.title: Stockouts cost NOK 23.8M of gross margin YTD
documents.source_ref: SDP lost-sales model — POS demand vs on-shelf availability, Jan–Sep 2026
documents.excerpt: Lost sales from stockouts are NOK 64.2M YTD (NOK 23.8M gross margin): Intersport NOK 15.0M, Sport 1 NOK 6.4M, Anton Sport NOK 2.4M of margin. On-shelf availability is 93.4% against a 96% target.

documents.title: Anton Sport summer sale returned −NOK 4.1M margin ROI
documents.source_ref: SDP Promotion ROI — campaign uplift vs markdown & media cost
documents.excerpt: Units rose 14%, but markdown depth of 40% on lifestyle footwear and NOK 2.3M of media turned the campaign margin-negative. Black Friday 2026 should cap depth at 30% on full-price lines.
